create_hierarchical_chunker: create a HierarchicalChunker to split a DoclingDocument into structured chunks with heading context
run_chunker: run HierarchicalChunker.chunk on a DoclingDocument to yield DocChunk objects with text and metadata
build_triplet_table_serializer: build a TripletTableSerializer that converts TableItem cells into row, column = value triplets
create_doc_meta: create a DocMeta instance with doc_items, headings, and origin for chunk metadata
create_doc_chunk: create a DocChunk with serialized text and DocMeta containing heading hierarchy and source items
